name: block-row
description: One text block in a list of blocks: the text and, on hover, its actions. Kind "source" is a block to pick (Add; shaded once already used); kind "editable" has a drag handle, Edit / Delete and an in-place edit mode.

props.name: included
props.description: Kind "source": the block is already in the document (row shaded, Add hidden).

rationale: Rows have no hairlines and no vertical rules, unlike table-row: Figma draws these panes as flat block lists on white, each row its text with a trailing blank line, so min-height is spacing.9 + spacing.6 (60px) and padding spacing.cell (10px). Hover and focus-within fill bg.surface-pressed. Actions and the drag icon are at opacity 0 until hover or focus (or edit mode), like table-row's hover-only icons, so a long list reads as text first; keyboard focus keeps them reachable. An already-included source block is shaded (Figma base/warm-100 in light, bg.surface-pressed in dark) and its Add button is visibility:hidden, not removed, so the row keeps its width. Edit mode swaps the text for a textarea with an accent border and drops the text padding, so the box sits where the text was. Drag and drop is driven by the host page through data-dragging (dimmed) and data-drop="before"/"after" (an accent line on the top or bottom edge), the same attribute API table-row offers. Not sourced from Figma: the hover / focus reveal of the actions. Rendering verified in light and dark themes.
a11y_notes: Rows are <li> inside a <ul class="ds-block-list">; give the list an aria-label. Actions are real buttons; the drag handle is a plain element with a labelled icon (drag and drop has no keyboard equivalent here, the host page must offer one if it matters).
